_: FLUX 3 video. Four routes at full quality, the same four as drafts, an extend pair, and an enhancer that turns a draft into a finished render. Priced per second of output from fal's own page; the drafts are one flat 720p rate.

blackforestlabs/flux-3/text-to-video.description: Black Forest Labs' video model at full quality: a clip from a sentence.

pricing.note: fal publishes $0.17 per second of output at 720p and $0.29 at 1080p. Priced from the 720p default. Its length defaults to auto, which is not a number, so the hold assumes FLUX 3's twenty second ceiling and settle returns whatever was not used. Pick a length and the quote is exact.

blackforestlabs/flux-3/text-to-video/dra.description: The same shot at a third of the price and a fraction of the wait: a clip from a sentence, rough. Find the shot here, then run the enhancer on it.

pricing.note: fal publishes a flat $0.06 per second of 720p draft output. Its length defaults to auto, which is not a number, so the hold assumes FLUX 3's twenty second ceiling and settle returns whatever was not used. Pick a length and the quote is exact.
